What is PHP File Handling? File handling in PHP allows you to create, read, write, edit, and delete files stored on the server. It is useful for storing data without a database. Examples include storing feedback, reading configuration files, or saving logs and reports. File Opening Modes in PHP r → Read only (starts at beginning)
w → Write only (erases old content)
a → Write only (adds new data at end)
x → Creates a new file (error if exists)
r+ → Read/write (starts at beginning)
w+ → Read/write (erases old content)
a+ → Read/write (adds data at end)
x+ → Read/write (error if exists)
The file pointer shows where PHP begins reading or writing.
